description: Create ADMISSIONTYPEHISTORY (dated admission type of an admission) if missing
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
preRequisites: Run migration.sql by hand on the database BEFORE deploying a build that maps AdmissionTypeHistory. The migration page only gets this file in that same build, so it cannot run this step first.
Without this table the interim and final bill of every admission fails to load.
Idempotent; changes no data. Existing admissions get no row and keep their current admission type for the whole stay.
rollbackNotes: rollback.sql drops ADMISSIONTYPEHISTORY. The dated history of changed admission types is lost; every admission then uses its current type for the whole stay.
